correctness.rationale: For small h the unique scalar positive branch exists globally: elimination gives a monotone scalar root, and summing midpoint chain-rule errors gives the uniform O(h²) auxiliary-manifold estimate. The exact modified-energy identity makes the auxiliary monotone. The limiting defect is h²/24 times the integral of f'''(u)u^6 plus O(h⁴). Differentiation, substitution, exact antiderivative and unique quadratic root yield the displayed signed coefficient. The included standard-library verifier passed rational polynomial checks and numerical recurrence diagnostics. Infinite asymptotics rest on the analytic argument, not finite tests.

value.rationale: The auxiliary variable is designed to encode a physical energy shift. A signed long-time manifold defect measures a different and mathematically important property from auxiliary energy dissipation. Exact crossover at the natural ratio F(a)/C and cancellation from O(h²) to O(h⁴) supply a motivated test and a shift-selection principle for quartic-gradient midpoint SAV; no broad accuracy claim is needed.
